name: Strikeforce Kitty 2
summary:
Strikeforce Kitty is back! Evil foxes have attacked again. We've sent our gallant kittens on an epic adventure to conquer the foxes' fortress!

The purr-fect runner. Funny, addictive, and full of surprises! Unlock upgrades and collect items and clothes for your kittens. Create their own unique outfits or wear popular costumes like the Batman or Darth Vader suits!

- 200 Costumes
- 31 Super costumes
- 21 Artifacts! Reincarnate your kittens with super costumes!
- 4 Bosses
- 5 Worlds
- 20 Locations
- Over 6 hours of gameplay
- Unique levels! Earn skills to unlock secret places and open chests!
- 12 Kitten abilities
